lead_raw_text:
The structure of Pr2Fe10Si2 (reduced formula PrFe5Si) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over 5 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe centers with 11, 13, and 14 geometric neighbors, while Pr centers have 14 neighbors and Si centers have 7. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between Fe and Pr polyhedra, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Fe-centered 14-vertex polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions across all 14 sites.
